inputs.drivers: Strategic autonomy; semiconductors and AI; shipbuilding and defence; power; quantum, space, and fusion; multi-year budgets; governance; wages; asset allocation; yen and JGB yields.
inputs.invalidation: The political premise is wrong or changes, budgets dilute, projects fail to become orders, capacity constrains delivery, JGB or yen moves impair valuation, or expectations already price the policy.
inputs.seed_claim: A proposed Takaichi-era Japanese strategic-investment framework may support selective rerating and earnings upgrades across strategic industrial domains if roadmaps become funded procurement and orders.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed asserts 17 strategic domains and requires policy roadmaps to become budget allocations, procurement, backlog, margin mix, and earnings revisions.
inputs.value_chain: Semiconductor equipment and test; defence and shipbuilding; power equipment; robotics, automation, and digital infrastructure; Tokyo Electron, Advantest, Mitsubishi Heavy, Kawasaki Heavy, Hitachi, and broad-Japan hedges.

objective: Research one Japan strategic-investment value-chain idea without assuming the political premise.
